name: io.github.tonyyang0504/taboola-mcp
description: Taboola Realize (Taboola Ads) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget. E

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TABOOLA_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Backstage API client_id provided by your Taboola account manager.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TABOOLA_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The matching client_secret; client-credentials tokens last 12 hours (no refresh token) and are re-requested automatically.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TABOOLA_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Taboola account_id (the string id, e.g. demo-advertiser, from list_accounts) used by update_budget and pause_resume, whose paths are /backstage/api/1.0/{account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}.
